request_unit_definition: One counted expert request = one occurrence of one expert id within one token's selected-expert tuple (Trace.token_selections(layer, phase)), for one (layer_id, expert_id) pair. This is the token-expert ASSIGNMENT unit -- the router's raw per-token top-k selection -- not the cache-access/residency-event unit R2-01..R2-04 use (the per-step-per-layer union across tokens). Duplicate expert ids within one token's tuple, if any, are each counted separately: never deduplicated.
